records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ben,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Silver Logistics* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:d99eede0, email:1c09afb6). No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Starter plan, 8 days left. Fully silent accounts rarely self-activate.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ben,

Following up on my last note — no pressure at all. Most teams get the most out of Wrenfield once there's a first project in place, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I can walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything else as we go.

Best,
Priya
